description.silhouette: Square stone plinth, 0.70 m, centred under a turret on a fort deck
description.colors: Weathered grey field stone matching the fort's thresholds, a dark iron anchor plate, moss in shaded seams
description.anatomy: Strict orthographic top-down. One dressed block with chamfered edges and a few weathered patches, a central iron anchor plate with bolts and the post socket. Broad values stay readable at 22 px.
